cause.statement: The sign-in was NOT rejected. On the only attempt whose receipt survives (2026-10-11T11:19:18Z), the runner found the sign-in form at step 0, submitted it, and then classified every one of steps 1 to 7 as CH-AUTHENTICATED while the session probe never passed; the loop therefore ran out at MAX_STEPS=8 and threw the generic NO_AUTHENTICATED_PROBE. The failure is in the authenticated-probe leg after a submission, not in the credential exchange. The underlying condition is most likely the one MEASURED on this host on 2026-09-24 and recorded in the library's own comment at ycharts_session.js:1042-1050 -- the signed-out public page satisfies the app-chrome selector model, so every step reads CH-AUTHENTICATED and the probe can never pass without an identity cookie. The library has an EXPLICIT failure for exactly that condition, SIGNED_OUT_APP_CHROME, carrying the DOM evidence a diagnosis needs; but it is gated on `!filled`, so it is unreachable once a submission has happened, and the post-submission case degrades to the uninformative NO_AUTHENTICATED_PROBE. That gating is why this read cannot close the last step.
cause.inferred_from: The step list is MEASURED. What the step list cannot distinguish is (a) the submission succeeded and the probe or identity-cookie leg is broken, from (b) the submission failed and the vendor returned a signed-out page that matches app chrome, with no re-presented form so SIGNIN_FORM_REPRESENTED never fired either. The two receipt members that would separate them, login_submission (whether the posted fields equalled the secret's, and the vendor's reply status) and probe_pair, are exactly the members run_capture refuses to propagate and nothing writes to disk.
evidence_lines: the same file, steps 1 through 7: '[ycharts-session] step N: state=CH-AUTHENTICATED via=dom' (seven lines)
ycharts_session.js:126 const MAX_STEPS = parseInt(process.env.YC_MAX_STEPS || '8', 10) -- eight steps is the loop's bound, matching the eight lines exactly
ycharts_session.js:1168-1176 throw new AuthError('did not reach an authenticated probe within MAX_STEPS', { reason: 'NO_AUTHENTICATED_PROBE', ... })

ycharts_session.js:1042-1050, the MEASURED 2026-09-24 comment: 'the PUBLIC page satisfies the app-chrome selector model ... so every step read CH-AUTHENTICATED, the probe could never pass without an identity cookie, and the loop ran to MAX_STEPS without ever submitting'

ycharts_session.js:1041 `if (!probe.authenticated && probe.reason === 'NO_IDENTITY_COOKIE' && !filled)` -- the explicit SIGNED_OUT_APP_CHROME diagnosis is gated on !filled and so cannot fire after step 0 submitted
ycharts_session.js:1136-1142, the AuthError SIGNIN_FORM_REPRESENTED branch, which did NOT fire: the form never came back after the submit
host sha256 of ycharts_session.js is 857d90b81960d69a7a6700be6fffe33d86628694aef95f8cfb64aca7a82cb839, EQUAL to the repo bytes at box/dell2 HEAD, so the code quoted above is the code that ran
cause.account_lockout_assessment: The journal shows the design bounded repeated sign-in rather than looping. For each job the durable intent permits exactly ONE session refresh: the second eviction on the same job is refused BEFORE any login with SESSION_REFRESH_ALREADY_USED, which happened at 11:34:05Z today and on four earlier days. Across the 14-day window there were 10 sign-in-bearing attempts, each on a different job or day, spaced by the 900 s capture cooldown. Nothing in what was read suggests a tight retry loop against the vendor. Whether the vendor considers the account locked is NOT established here: no vendor call was made and the login secret's LastAccessedDate is day-granular.

Every resident READY line has the single shape 'IRPT_RESIDENT_RESOLVE state=READY code=-'. A census of IRPT_RESIDENT_RESOLVE fields over the whole window returns only state= (READY 64, RETRY 34, ATTENTION 11): no field names the branch, so a vendor-path READY cannot be distinguished from an Opal-producer READY in the journal.
